utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking with a couple people while I’m out, but I’ll let you know as soon as I pin down a time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — just let me know when you’ve pinned it down, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. I’ll update you as soon as I’ve got the time set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Vik — if you happen to spot the loose fence panel by my place, that’d be a huge help. I’ve been meaning to fix it, but I’ve been a bit all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll swing by the repair drive, let folks know the plan, and I’ll keep an eye out for that loose fence panel by your place too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. I’ll try to remember to swing by and help if I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks — that’d help a lot. I’ll swing by if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good, Noah. I’ll keep the list moving and let you know if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — appreciate it. Just let me know if you need me to grab anything.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — if the repair drive needs tools, I’ve got a few I can lend.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll make a clear list so we know what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — send the list my way and I’ll grab what I can from the garage.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning around 10 still works for me, and I’m happy to work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Mara — 10 works great, and I really appreciate you working around the school schedule. I’ll spread the word and keep you posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Quinn — I appreciate it. Let me know if anything changes, and I’ll stay flexible around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep — at the community center parking lot Saturday morning, with a labeled drop-off table by the front doors. If you’re coming by, that’s the spot to use.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, that works — I’ll use the community center parking lot Saturday morning and the labeled table by the front doors. Thanks for the clear spot to drop things off.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — see you then, and thanks for helping out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll start a quick volunteer list and match each person with the repair items they can handle.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect — I’ll keep the supply table organized and make sure we’ve got everything ready for the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Cleo — thanks for keeping the supply table in order. I’ll round up the volunteers and pair them with the right repair tasks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh right, the community center parking lot on Saturday morning, with the labeled table by the front doors. I’ll plan to stop by then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Saturday morning at the community center works for me. Thanks — I’ll plan to be there too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Perfect — I’ll see you there Saturday morning. Thanks for confirming!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking those basics — if you have the date, location, or supply list, send them my way and I’ll organize the rest.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I don’t have the date, location, or supply list yet, but I can help track them down. Tell me what you need first, and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great — let’s start with the date first, then location, then supplies. If you can find even one of those, send it over and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m on it — I’ll find out the exact time and where they need people most, then I’ll come right back to you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I appreciate that. I’ll be ready once you have the time and spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I just heard they need the most help between 10 and noon over by the community center entrance — I’ll keep an ear out for any changes and let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Supplies would be great — whatever you can bring helps.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — I’ll bring what I can and keep it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Faye — that works. Just drop them off when you can around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m still on for the donation drop-off and keeping track of the extra tools. Just tell me when and where to pick them up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Sam, you’re picking up the extra tools for the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’m picking up the extra tools for the repair drive and will keep track of them. Just send me the time and place.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
